capabilities: Lock embedded .base files to hide their toolbar
Disable header (column) interaction on locked Bases
Toggle lock state by rewriting embed syntax flags (|x / |o)
Lock inline base code blocks via a fence flag
Unlock by hovering a lock button above the Base
disambiguation: Not a security or access-control feature; locking only hides the toolbar and disables header clicks in Reading view.
extras: Works only in Reading view, on desktop and mobile; only the .base embed in the current document is modified. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: lets you hide the Bases toolbar and disable header interaction on demand
problem: Embedded Bases show an action toolbar and allow accidental column changes when you just want to read the note.

relations.evidence: Make sure the official Bases core plugin is also enabled

summary: Bases add-on that locks embedded Bases in Reading view, hiding the toolbar and disabling header interaction until unlocked.
